Enumerate the same payment-relation source keys and read only event identity and roles. Preserve explicit discrete payments, payer, patient and amount. Also preserve actual source-established plan events, their sponsor and beneficiaries; a person is not a plan merely because the native program tests plan_(person). Wages establish payment, while work alone does not. Unresolved roles or incomplete enumeration are unread.
Read only the declared fields event_kind. Keep other attributes unread; do not supply their values.
Read facts only. Preserve current source keys. Do not infer missing dates, people or places. Complete scans enumerate every relevant source record. Ambiguity is unread. Return the named relation wrapper.
